title: Junior System Modeling
description:
About Unconventional AI
We are rethinking the foundations of the computer to optimize energy efficiency for AI. Founded by pioneers in the field - including Naveen Rao (Nervana, MosaicML) and Michael Carbin (MIT, MosaicML) - we are building a new computational substrate that interfaces directly with the physics of silicon to achieve biology-scale efficiency. We recently raised $475M in seed funding to turn this vision into reality.
As a Junior Member of Technical Staff, System Modeling , you will work closely with senior engineers to contribute to the development of our multi-disciplinary simulation frameworks. You will assist the hands-on R&D team in building simulation environments that enable rapid iteration and testing across all layers of our unconventional physics-based computing systems for machine learning workloads. Your work will focus on integrating physics-based models, developing GPU-accelerated simulations, and supporting the cross-layer system integration necessary for "Extreme co-design".
Key Responsibilities

•
Contribute to the implementation and optimization of GPU-accelerated simulators for ML on analog/unconventional hardware, focusing on specific modules and features within PyTorch.

•
Assist in integrating physics-based device and system models into the PyTorch simulation environment to help expose early algorithm-hardware tradeoffs and enable cross-layer optimization.

•
Support the maintenance and extension of the unified end-to-end simulation environment, helping to link theory, algorithms, and device models, and ensuring alignment between high-level and near-physical simulators.

•
Help implement and adhere to robust experiment tracking protocols to ensure simulation results, configurations, and non-idealities are reproducible and auditable.

•
Collaborate with Algorithms and Hardware teams to gather requirements and ensure the modeling environment meets their needs for high-level algorithm development and lower-level hardware verification.

What We’re Looking For

•
Strong Systems Foundation: A BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. You should have a deep understanding of computer architecture and operating systems.

•
Coding Proficiency: Strong skills in C++ and Python . You should be comfortable writing performance-critical code.

•
AI/ML Exposure: Basic familiarity with the internals of deep learning frameworks (e.g., how a PyTorch graph is executed) and common model architectures.

•
Mathematical Intuition: A solid grasp of linear algebra and calculus, which are essential for understanding both neural dynamics and hardware optimizations.

•
First Principles Mindset: You enjoy digging into "why" things work (or don't) and aren't afraid to challenge conventional software "best practices" to find a more efficient path.

Bonus Points

• Experience with compilers (LLVM, MLIR) or domain-specific languages like Triton .

• Exposure to GPU programming (CUDA) or other hardware accelerators.

• Prior research or internship experience in high-performance computing (HPC) or neuromorphic systems.

• Contributions to open-source AI or systems software projects.

Why Join Us?

•
Mentorship: Learn directly from the architects who built the modern AI stack at companies like Intel, Databricks, and NVIDIA.

•
Impact: You won't be a small cog in a giant machine. You will be helping build the machine itself.

•
Unconventional Problems: Work on challenges that don't have a StackOverflow answer-you’ll be defining the future of AI compute.

•
Competitive Package: Significant equity and competitive salary at a well-funded, high-growth startup.

title: Head of Predictions & Optimization
salary: $250K – $350K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • up to 40% annual performance bonus; paid up to 10% quarterly
description:
Confido is the AI infrastructure powering modern CPG - the platform that 200+ brands like OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Dr. Squatch, and Tropicana use to run everything from deductions to production planning. Finance, accounting, sales, and operations, unified in one system for the first time.

We're growing 5x year over year with a small team in New York City; the people who join now will shape the product, the culture, and the company itself.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere - and outsized ownership while you build - we'd love to meet you.

THE ROLE

Tell brands what to charge, which promotions to run, and where. Back it with data almost no one else has.

Confido sees what's actually happening in the physical world of CPG: shipments, depletions, inventory, consumption, what's on the shelf, merchandising, deductions, the demographics of who lives near each store, and forward-looking promo plans. That means rich actuals and a real view of the future, across hundreds of brands. Most of this data isn't publicly available anywhere.

As Head of Prediction & Optimization, you'll build and lead Confido's data science function, starting with our newest product area: Revenue Growth Management (RGM). You'll own the models that turn a detailed picture of the business into decisions brands actually act on, and you'll grow the team to 3+ data scientists.

Location: New York, NY (Relocation supported)

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead pricing and trade optimization for RGM, including price elasticity, promo lift, cannibalization, and halo effects, so you can answer "how much should I charge for this?"

- Build promotion recommendations that get specific. Should a promo run 4 weeks or 8? Should it be a deeper discount, a BOGO, or buy-3-get-1? Which regions, retailers, and accounts should get it?

- Turn predictions into prescriptions by building optimization that works under real constraints like trade budgets, margin targets, and retailer calendars

- Measure what actually worked, using post-event analysis, causal inference, and baselines that brands trust enough to change their plans

- Partner with our AI/ML engineers to take models to production, and set the bar for backtesting, evaluation, and monitoring

- Build the team: hire and mentor data scientists, and set the roadmap and technical direction alongside our CTO and AI research lead

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

- 7+ years of applied data science or predictive modeling, including experience leading projects or people

- Deep expertise in statistical modeling and ML for pricing, demand, or forecasting, such as elasticity, causal inference, or uplift modeling

- Experience building optimization or decision-support models, beyond predictions alone

- Strong Python and SQL, plus rigor about validation: you know how to avoid leakage and when to distrust a good-looking result

- The ability to turn a model into a clear recommendation a non-technical business user will act on

Nice to have

- RGM, trade promotion, pricing, or revenue management experience in CPG, retail, or marketplaces

- Experience with syndicated or retailer data (Nielsen, SPINS, Circana, retailer POS)

- Taking models to production yourself. We're indexed on modeling, but end-to-end is a plus

- Operations research or mathematical optimization (MIP, solvers)

- Startup or 0-to-1 team-building experience

🌴 PERKS + BENEFITS

- Equity - own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build

- Fully paid health coverage through Aetna - we cover 100% of employee premiums

- Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian

- Carrot Fertility Pro - comprehensive fertility and family-forming support

- 12 weeks of paid parental leave

- Unlimited PTO - plus regular 4-day holiday weekends we actually take

- 401(k) through Vestwell

- Paid relocation support - we’ll help you make the move to NYC

- Fully equipped workspace from day one - laptop, monitor, keyboard, and a $200 stipend to personalize your setup

title: Law Clerk
description:
Litigation Law Clerk

About The Employment Law Group

The Employment Law Group (TELG) helps employees to stand up for their rights and to stand against wrongdoing in the workplace. Our practice areas include discrimination and retaliation, whistleblower law, and employee contracts. We're biased, of course, but we believe we're among the best employment law firms in the country. Our top attorneys have decades of courtroom experience and have won favorable outcomes for employees and whistleblowers in settlements and at dozens of trials - the ultimate test of a lawyer's skills. Our firm’s work enables employees to meet their employers on a level playing field.

About the Job

The Employment Law Group is looking for part-time law students - primarily second-year evening law students - to join our team as full-time litigation law clerks. We will consider first-year, second-semester students if they have strong, relevant work experience at a law firm. Law clerks gain hands-on experience that develops their legal skills under attorney supervision. They work directly with principals and associates to provide substantive assistance through all phases of negotiation, litigation, trial, and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Case management of a diverse portfolio of legal matters

• Preliminary drafts of legal documents including complaints, motions and oppositions, discovery requests and responses, deposition notes, and appeals motions

• Extensive client contact

• Communication with opposing counsel, co-counsel, and experts

• Legal research

• Trial preparation and on-site trial support, as needed

• Calendaring of meetings, depositions, hearings, trial dates, and other events

• Client billing, including daily time entries

• Other responsibilities as assigned

This is a highly demanding position when combined with law school obligations. The ideal candidate is a proactive and highly motivated professional with strong organizational, legal writing, time management, and communication skills.

Requirements

• Enrolled in a part-time JD program at an ABA - accredited law school

• Full availability for *all* aspects of work during regular hours (9:00am - 5:00pm ET)

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite

• Legal research skills

• Command of Bluebook standards for legal citation

• Ability to multitask, prioritize work, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

• Attention to detail and a high level of accuracy in work product

• Professional demeanor

We favor second-year evening law students; applicants with strong, relevant legal experience; and applicants who already are working full-time. We will consider first-year evening law students if they have successfully completed one semester; if they have strong, relevant legal experience; *and* if they already are working full-time. In general, we will not consider third-year students. Fourth-year students and JD holders *cannot* become law clerks

What TELG Offers

• Competitive salary starting at $70,000.00

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance with generous employer contribution

• 401(k) matching

• Paid holidays and personal leave

• Paid educational leave for law clerks, including time off for exams

• Gym reimbursements

This is an excellent opportunity for part-time students to put their education into practice, to gain a better understanding of how lawyers really work, and to see first-hand how they can improve the lives of clients.

Application Process

Interested applicants must apply via our website and should submit a letter of interest, a resume, an up-to-date unofficial transcript from law school, and a writing sample (legal writing strongly preferred).

Applicants who move forward will be required to take a writing and editing test and, before a hiring decision, to participate in interviews.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

- Du gibst dein Wissen weiter - im Roleplay, im Shadowing und im Austausch mit Kolleg:innen, die neu dabei sind.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg, von der Kaltakquise bis zum Closing.

- Du bist es gewohnt, an KPIs gemessen zu werden und hast deine eigenen Zahlen stets im Blick.

- Du schaffst es, ein komplexes Produkt verständlich zu vermitteln und dabei zu begeistern.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Klare Entwicklungschancen: Nächste Senioritätsstufen erreichst du mit deiner Performance - simpel gehalten und schnell erreichbar. Außerdem besetzen wir Team-Lead-Rollen bevorzugt aus dem eigenen Team und begleiten den Weg dorthin mit unserer Sales Manager Academy.

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

Your mission as Growth Marketing Manager is to own consumer traffic growth across our portals end to end. You will protect and grow our largest market (Benelux), where the bulk of today's traffic sits, while building a repeatable acquisition playbook to scale our newer Promozilla portals from a standing start. Day 30: You've achieved full campaign continuity with zero disruption to active Benelux flows, and audited traffic sources across the portal network - establishing a clear baseline of what drives volume in each live market and a working relationship with product and development.
Day 60: You've identified the highest-yield channel per market and the friction points capping growth (technical, behavioral, or distributional), and shipped your first round of experiments - across organic, paid, social, partnerships, or lifecycle - with early measurable lift.

High Autonomy, Low Ego : In a remote-first, async environment, the work speaks for itself. You're motivated by solving hard distribution problems, not by synchronous cheerleading, and you're comfortable being judged on the real health of portal traffic and retention.

A demonstrable track record of using generative AI and automation to scale campaign copy and localization, build programmatic reporting loops, and trigger automated workflows. Estamos presentes en 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Ecuador y Panamá) y contamos con un hub de tecnología en Portugal , reuniendo a más de 3.100 personas unidas por el desafío de transformar el sector. Con el respaldo de inversionistas globales como SoftBank, General Atlantic y Kaszek, hemos levantado más de US$ 755 millones y hoy somos una compañía valuada en US$ 5,1 mil millones .

Lidermos la transformación del mercado siendo pioneros en la aplicación de Inteligencia Artificial a gran escala en el sector inmobiliario. title: Senior Manager Logistics (f/m/d)
description:
ABOUT US

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects.

ABOUT OUR TECHNOLOGY

The semiconductor industry's growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude. In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.

THE ROLE

At Black Semiconductor, logistics is more than moving materials from A to B. It is the infrastructure that keeps our operations running as we move towards production, it is becoming increasingly business-critical.

We are looking for a Senior Manager to take ownership of this function and help build it for our next stage of growth. This is a role for someone who enjoys both getting things done and building them up properly: you will participate in day-to-day operations, while at the same time developing the processes, structures and supply chain setup we need for the future.

Today, our logistics setup is very lean, giving you significant ownership from day one. With the setup and scaling of our main headquarters and new facility (FabONE), you will play a key role in scaling Black Semiconductor’s our operational capabilities as the company moves into production.

TO JOIN OUR TEAM, YOU SHOULD BE EXCITED TO:

- Build and lead the logistics team and warehouse operations, providing both functional and disciplinary leadership.

- To keep products moving, ensure reliable day-to-day logistics operations across domestic and international transportation, shipping and distribution, taking a hands-on approach where needed.

- Develop and optimize processes across warehousing, receiving, inventory, transportation, shipping and production support.

- Drive initiatives to improve efficiency, quality, cost performance and delivery reliability, like our SAP S/4HANA rollout, establishing RASIC and best practices to building the team and capabilities needed for future growth.

- Work closely with internal stakeholders across production, engineering, procurement and other business functions to ensure a reliable flow of materials and information.

- Own dangerous goods handling and regulatory compliance, ensuring adherence to ADR, IATA, IMDG, and all relevant legal requirements

- Ensure that compliance is an integral part of our logistics processes right from the start.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

- 6+ years of hands-on experience in logistics or warehouse management, import/export or manufacturing operations

- At least 4 years of disciplinary leadership and people management experience, ideally with responsibility for teams with 5+ employees

- Experience in a startup/scale-up environment or complex corporate organization, ideally in semiconductor, pharmaceutical or another highly regulated industry

- Strong hands-on experience with WMS and ERP systems (SAP/S/4HANA experience is a plus)

- Proven expertise in dangerous goods, German regulatory requirements and compliance, ideally combined with cleanroom logistics experience

- A pragmatic leadership mindset, strategic thinking, and strong problem-solving as well as stakehold

title: Associate Counsel, Regulatory
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. As part of Waymo's Legal team, you will work on the exciting legal issues surrounding our transformational autonomous driving technology and help drive our business lines forward from technology ideation through scaled commercial deployment. We collaborate with our engineering, product, strategy and operations teams to develop and protect our intellectual property portfolio and drive our corporate and commercial transactions. • Advise on the applicability of U.S. state and local legal frameworks to novel operational scenarios and cutting-edge autonomous vehicle technology.

• Partner with cross-functional partners to support ground-breaking regulatory and legislative outcomes for the transportation industry.

• Represent Waymo’s legal and regulatory interests, fostering constructive, proactive relationships with government authorities and key agency stakeholders.

• Advise teams building scalable operational and regulatory compliance programs and processes.

• Support the expansion of highly regulated business operations.

• Gain subject matter expertise in new areas as novel issues and topics emerge.

You have:

• Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school and active bar membership.

• 2 to 4+ years of experience as an attorney at a firm, in-house at a company, or in government, practicing in the area of administrative law, agency regulations, regulatory legislation and/or compliance.

• Experience with relevant subject matter such as autonomous vehicles, other automotive, ride-hailing, delivery.

• Strong analytical acumen and legal comprehension, complemented by exceptional written and oral communication skills.

• Experience responding to regulatory inquiries, audits, and information requests, in partnership with with engineering, data science, product, safety, and compliance teams.

• Demonstrated ability to propose practical solutions to legal issues and lead legal compliance and risk mitigation efforts, executing with appropriate urgency.

We prefer:

• Experience securing operating authority and navigating complex regulatory approvals.

• Familiarity with appellate litigation strategies and proceedings relevant to judicial review of agency decisions and actions.

description:

• Cloud-Native Development: Architect and build high-performance web applications using React, Node.js, and TypeScript. You will own the full lifecycle, from frontend UI components to backend business logic.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Lead the implementation of cloud environments
using Terraform. You will treat infrastructure as a first-class citizen, ensuring all client environments are reproducible, version-controlled, and secure.

• Automation & CI/CD: Build and manage automated pipelines that bridge the gap between application code and infrastructure deployment, ensuring a seamless "push-to-deploy" experience.

• Consultative Leadership: Act as a subject matter expert in client "pods" mentoring junior engineers and confidently presenting architectural roadmaps to customer stakeholders.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• Proven commercial experience within a Full Stack Development role.

• Highly experienced in event driven architectures.

• Experience of engineering for Mobile to create modular, reusable components.

• Strong experience of AWS Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tooling such as Terraform as well as AWS Serverless e.g Lambda.

• Strong experience of automation, CI/CD principles and experience with tools like Jenkins, Github Actions, GitLab CI, or AWS CodePipeline.

• Experience of RestAPI’s as well as wider 3rd Party API’s.

• Experience using GraphQL.

• Strong working knowledge of containerisation technologies (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes, ECS).

• Automated Test experience.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to engage with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• A consultative mindset with strong problem-solving and analytical skills and ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• Comfortable working in agile, client-facing environments with autonomy and ownership.

• Able to commute when required for client or team sessions (occasional).

Benefits

• Remote-first working with flexibility around client needs.

• Private health insurance.

• Projects with global brands & public sector leaders, working on real-world impact.

• Exclusive access to AWS & Databricks certifications, training, and partner tools.

• A collaborative culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.

• Competitive salary, bonus structure, and long-term growth opportunities.

• Hold a C1 Certificate in Medical German

• Professional fluency in English, to work with our English Medical Team

What you’ll do:

• Review patient consultations, assess medical histories and clinical images, and diagnose, prescribe and manage treatment plans for patients in Germany

• Act as a point of escalation for patient queries, working closely with our Customer Support Team and our dermatologists to ensure we provide the best care

• Contribute to the ongoing development of our consultation model, clinical pathways and digital workflows within a dynamic start-up environment

• Maintain a strong focus on clinical quality, patient safety and prescribing governance

• Work closely with our in-house medical leadership and wider clinical team, and continuously develop your clinical knowledge through regular CPD sessions with our dermatologists

• Monitor and uphold prescribing safety and quality standards

Working pattern:

• This is a full-time, permanent employment contract (umowa o pracę), 5 days per week

• May include some weekend work on a rota basis (e.g. 1 weekend in every 5)

• Fully remote, working from Poland

Why should you choose Skin + Me ?

• A daily challenge - a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment where no two days are the same

• Make a difference - help improve the skin health and confidence of thousands of patients across Germany

• Support network - work alongside experienced medical leaders, investors, and advisors who have built some of the world’s best consumer health companies

title: Appeals and Grievances Clinical Specialist III
description:

We're a team that owns our work with accountability, makes data-driven decisions, embraces continuous learning, and celebrates collaboration - because success is a team sport. It's our mission to be there in the moments that matter most for our members and employees. Join us in creating a community of connected care, where coordinated, quality service is the norm and every member feels valued.
The Appeals and Grievances Clinical Specialist III position is responsible for the review, investigation, and resolution of member and provider appeals and grievances requiring clinical expertise. This role ensures compliance with regulatory requirements, accreditation standards, and organizational policies while promoting quality outcomes, member satisfaction, and STARs performance. The specialist works collaboratively with medical directors, clinical staff, and operational teams to support timely and accurate determinations and oversee clinician-to-clinician (C2C) challenge activities.
Key Responsibilities

• Conduct clinical review of member and provider appeals, including pre-service, concurrent, and post-service cases.

• Evaluate medical necessity, appropriateness of care, and benefit coverage using clinical guidelines and evidence-based criteria.

• Investigate grievances by reviewing medical records, claims, and related documentation to determine root cause and resolution.

• Prepare clear, concise, and compliant determination letters that meet regulatory and accreditation standards (e.g., CMS, NCQA).

• Collaborate with Medica l Directors for cases requiring physician review and support case presentations as needed.

• Oversee and support Clinician-to-Clinician (C2C) challenges, including coordination, documentation, and ensuring timely completion in accordance with regulatory requirements.

• Monitor and assess the impact of appeals and grievances on STARs measures, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities for performance improvement.

• Partner with quality and operations teams to address trends that may negatively impact STARs ratings and member experience.

• Ensure all appeals and C2C activities are processed within required turnaround times.

• Identify trends, quality concerns, and potential process improvement opportunities through case analysis.

• Maintain accurate and complete documentation in case management systems.

• Serve as a clinical resource for non-clinical staff regarding appeals, grievance processes, and clinical escalation pathways.

• Participate in audits, regulatory reporting, and quality improvement initiatives as required.

Education & Experience

• Active, unrestricted RN license required

• 5+ years of clinical experience

• Prior experience in Appeals & Grievances, Utilization Management, or Managed Care strongly preferred.

• Experience with C2C processes, regulatory turnaround requirements, and STARs metrics preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Strong knowledge of medical terminology, clinical guidelines, and healthcare delivery systems.

• Understanding of regulatory requirements (CMS, Medica re/ Medica id, commercial guidelines, NCQA standards).

• Familiarity with STARs measures and how clinical decisions impact quality performance outcomes.

• Excellent critical thinking and clinical decision-making skills.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate clinical information into member-friendly language.

ABOUT BEAMERY

With the rapid expansion of AI and automation, the future of work has never been more challenging for organizations. Beamery’s unique jobs, skills and tasks data platform helps organizations navigate these challenges and make more informed decisions across Talent Lifecycle Management. Our solutions power recruitment, mobility, upskilling, diversity, work architecture and workforce planning for some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies.

We believe that where you work is much more than just a job. Millions of people are being left behind every day in their careers, and we’re on a mission to fix this by creating equal access to meaningful work, skills and careers for all.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a representative Beamery, creating an equitable, inclusive and engaging environment for our people.

So, what are you waiting for? Join us and help us transform the future of work once and for all.

What’s ahead - and why it’s an exciting time to join the team: 

Building agentic AI with advanced orchestration (multi-agent workflows, tool use, evaluation loops) that turns complex talent data into decisions.

- Training and fine-tuning our own models on unique data about jobs, skills and tasks, and benchmarking them against the best in our market.

- Joining an award-winning AI team (ACM RecSys Challenge 2026) that turns new ideas into innovative solutions with scientific rigour.

- Sharing our work and learning from industry peers through challenges, conferences and publications.

But it’s not all about creating high-quality products, we also very much value the company culture we have worked hard to create; built on trust, empathy & honesty ensuring our workforce is able to bring their full selves to work.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Data Science team builds the AI models behind Beamery's Data Foundry, the common data and AI layer powering all Beamery products, and works hand in hand with the product teams to empower their features with AI (such as Talent Match and recommendations). At the heart of our work is the Beamery taxonomy, the language of work (skills, role titles and tasks) that every Beamery product speaks, built on more than a decade of research and kept current by the Taxonomist, our agentic system, so it reflects the real pulse of the job market. We combine LLMs, Transformers and embedding models with classic machine learning, always choosing the best balance between quality, latency and cost.

We see ourselves as pioneers in AI for HR Tech: in 2026 the team finished 1st in the industry track and 2nd overall out of 40 teams at the ACM RecSys Challenge.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will join the team as a Senior Data Scientist and own our matching, recommendation and taxonomy mapping models, working closely with the product engineering teams that bring them to our customers. You will be responsible for the full cycle of your work, from defining how quality is measured and designing the models to running robust scientific experiments, tracking technical and business metrics, and writing and reviewing code. You will also advise the product teams on how to implement AI features with an evaluation-first mindset, and keep pushing the boundaries of Beamery's AI.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Build, improve and own our matching and recommendation models (e.g. candidate to job matching, internal mobility recommendations etc.).

- Apply an evaluation-first mindset: build golden datasets from real recruiter and user decisions, define quality metrics, design and run robust scientific experiments, track and report both technical and business metrics (using LLM-as-a-judge and human feedback), and communicate results and metrics clearly to the product teams.

- Write clean and tested Python code using AI coding agents (such as Claude Code or Codex), and review code with care, both from your peers and from AI agents, so the team's codebase stays consistent, readable and safe.

Ready to do your best work? Join us.
Build the "Un-buildable" on the Workday Platform.
Our Workday Extend team is small, agile, and growing at light speed. We don’t just "configure" Workday-we treat it as a development platform. We are looking for a Consultant who wants to move beyond standard modules and dive into the world of custom objects, event-driven orchestrations, and high-impact app development. This is a rare opportunity to be a founding member of a rapidly scaling Extend practice, where you will help define our development standards and build solutions that truly didn't exist before.

• Troubleshoot & Optimize: Debug complex logic within orchestrations and perform root-cause analysis on app performance or security issues.

• Practice Building: Contribute to our internal Reusable Solution Library . Since our team is small, your templates and "best practices" will become the foundation for all future hires.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Functional and Integration teams to ensure Extend apps integrate perfectly with core HCM, Finance, or Student modules.

Qualifications

• The Foundation: 3+ years of experience in Workday Extend.

Apogee Global RMS is seeking a Risk Analyst to support cross‑domain research, client engagements, and enterprise‑risk assessments. • Conduct cross‑domain risk research across strategic, operational, financial, human‑capital, cyber, and regulatory domains

Qualifications:

• Strong analytical and research skills

• Ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights

• Excellent written communication and documentation discipline

• Familiarity with risk concepts (enterprise risk, cyber risk, operational risk, human‑capital risk)

• Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast‑paced environment

• A structured thinker with strong analytical instincts

description:
Space Inch is looking for an Engineering Engagement Lead to look after our engineers within a long-standing partnership with one of the largest investment managers in the U.S, who is a S&P 500 company . Our engineers work embedded in the client’s teams, and the client directs their day-to-day work. Your job is everything around that work: making sure each engineer meets Space Inch ’s standards, understanding what they’re building and why it matters to the client’s business, helping them grow, and keeping communication clear between our people and the client.
This is a people, communication, and account role , which means that you won’t assign tasks, run sprints, or make architecture decisions. An engineering background is a preference, but it’s not a disqualifying criteria. What really matters is an engineer’s mindset : you can sit down with an engineer or a client’s engineering manager, understand what’s being built, and have a real conversation about it.
Our mission, vision, and values
At Space Inch , we prioritize alignment with our clients and team, ensuring a deep understanding of their needs. We are committed to delivering exceptional work while supporting the personal and professional growth of our team members.
Working at Space Inch

• Our remote-first team of around 80+ people is based across the EU (mostly Croatia), the US, and Latin America, with a growing presence in Brazil.

• Occasional travel for client visits and company retreats.

• This role is embedded within a single long-standing client partnership, though you'll draw on Space Inch 's broader engineering community and practices.

• We support work/life balance for our team.

Requirements

•
Experience : 10+ years in engineering and people leadership, engagement or account management, or technical project/product management in an agency, consultancy, nearshore, or client-embedded environment; preferably coming from an engineering background, but not a must.

•
An engineer’s mindset : you understand modern software development (SDLC, common architectures and stacks) well enough to follow what engineers are building, hold your own with client engineering and product managers, and notice when something is off. You don’t need to write code.

•
Real curiosity about the client’s business : you invest the time to learn the domain, why each application matters, and what workflow it replaces, so client stakeholders see you as someone who adds value.

•
A clear system for evaluating people : you can explain how you know someone is doing a great job, using standards, evidence, and feedback from several sources, and how you turn that into specific, actionable coaching.

•
Exceptional communicator and mediator who handles sensitive topics (compensation, retention, disengagement, underperformance) directly and with care, across written, async, live, and cross-cultural communication.

• Proven track record of growing engineers : you’ve guided engineers along their career paths, from junior to senior and from individual contributor toward leadership, built development plans that led to real promotions, and can point to people who grew under your leadership.

•
Experience managing senior client stakeholders : gathering honest feedback, managing expectations, and showing the value our people bring.

•
Practical fluency with AI as a working tool : you can assess whether engineers are using AI well against defined practices and push them to improve.

• Experience leading distributed or remote people, including those who work mostly on their own.

Key responsibilities

•
Evaluation against our standards : Regularly assess every engineer and project against Space Inch ’s project success standards, and whether we’re meeting both the client’s needs and our team members’ needs.

•
Client feedback loop : Work with the client’s engineering and product managers to gather feedback on each engineer, including quality of work, taking into account how each client team operates.

title: Project Manager (ERP Automation)
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!
Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.
Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.
To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.
BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.
Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.
Location
This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.
Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.
Your Mission
You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.
As a Project Manager , most of your implementations are not multi-year global programs. They are for companies that want blp running in their finance or supply chain organization within weeks, and who want somebody who knows what they are doing to take them through it. You are that person. You run the kick-off, work with them on scope and process, configure blp, coordinate the integration, take them through testing, and get them across the line at go-live.
You work in three modes, and many of our Project Managers move between them:

• Guided onboarding for our commercial customers: you run configuration days for several customers at once, guide them while they configure, and answer the questions that come up.

• Leading yourself on enterprise customers: you own the project end to end, including the sponsor meetings.

• Alongside a Senior Project Manager on our largest programs, where you take a country, an entity or a workstream and own it.

Your Career Path in Project Management
This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

• Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

• Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

• Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.
Key Responsibilities

• Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

• Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

• Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

title: Robotics Engineering Intern
description:
Robotics Engineering Intern

Role
We are looking for a fast learning robotics engineering intern with a hands on attitude to help coordinate our growing fleet, test robots and support customer deployments.

We are looking for someone to start as soon as possible, ideally by December 1st, for at least 6 months.

Key Responsibilities

• Investigate robot issues in the field, find the root cause and pinpoint which component is faulty.

• Design and run robot tests, both factory acceptance tests and pre deployment tests.

• Keep our robots running by using data analysis to find common failures and passing them to the development team.

• Coordinate the release of new software features and deploy them to the robot fleet.

Background

• Pursuing a BSc or MSc in robotics, mechanical engineering, computer science or equivalent.

• Hands on experience with robotics, ideally involving both software and hardware.

• Familiar with common robotics tools like Ubuntu, ROS, Python, shell, Docker, etc.

• Multidisciplinary and not scared to get your hands dirty, whether replacing robot parts or learning new programming languages and tools.

• Goal driven and independent: getting robots working properly is the top priority, and you can figure out how to do it.

• Good English skills (C1 level).

Honest comments

• You will learn a lot about robotics, infrastructure and testing in this role, but it is not a software development role. You will build tools to test and debug, but not core algorithms like navigation or perception.

• You will have to handle chaotic situations with several robot issues at the same time.

• If you think you don’t tick every box, don’t worry. We want someone who can learn fast and has the right attitude to make it work. So just give it a go. We reply to every application.

About Ascento
Ascento is an ETH Zurich spin off on a mission to bring the physical security industry into the digital era with robotics and AI. We build autonomous outdoor security robots and own the full stack: hardware, software and service operations, all offered as Robotics as a Service. Our robots protect data centers, logistics hubs, manufacturing sites, airports and other critical infrastructure in Switzerland, France, Belgium, Denmark, Austria and the US. Our customers include security companies and Fortune 500 companies. Our factories and repair hubs are in Zurich and New York.

Our values: Customer Trust Comes First, Own the Outcome, Move Fast, One Team High Standards, No Bullshit.

Ascento is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Please apply as soon as possible, as we need this person asap.

About  Corndel

Corndel is a unique, multi award-winning UK management and technology training provider that focuses on delivering the highest quality programmes throughout an employee’s career. We partner with some of the UK’s largest and most exciting businesses to help drive organisational and personal performance through transformational learning. Our vision is to shape a world where everyone is empowered to be their professional best. We are one of the fastest growing companies in the UK and provide a great platform for proactive and motivated individuals to take the next exciting step in their career. You will be joining an organisation with a fun, entrepreneurial and supportive environment, providing fulfilling work and an open, informal culture.

The Role
The AA4 Coach (Automation with AI) exists to help learners become confident, capable automation specialists who can design, build, and deploy AI powered workflows that deliver real productivity gains.
You’ll coach learners to design, build, and deploy AI‑powered automation solutions that deliver real business value. This is a hands‑on role combining deep technical expertise with a strong coaching mindset.
What You’ll Do

• Coach and mentor learners through 1‑to‑1 sessions and workshops

• Support learners to build low‑code and no‑code automations using Microsoft Power Platform

• Demonstrate best practice in workflow design, testing, documentation, and ethical AI use

• Troubleshoot and guide learners on real business automation challenges

• Support portfolio development and End Point Assessment readiness

What You’ll Bring

• Strong hands‑on experience with Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Power Apps, AI Builder, and Microsoft 365

• Experience translating business processes into working automations

• Confidence troubleshooting automation workflows and integrations

• Understanding of Responsible AI, data privacy, and security

• Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non‑technical learners

Why join  Corndel ?

• Fully remote role with flexible working

• Inclusive, values‑driven culture

• Opportunity to shape how AI automation is adopted responsibly across UK organisations

• Join a fast‑growing, award‑winning education provider

• Develop your career while helping others transform theirs

As part of our commitment to create an inclusive workplace where all colleagues can be their true selves, excel in their roles and progress in their careers, we recognise the importance of embracing the diversity in the working population and making  Corndel  a fully accessible employer.

Please note this does not mean that all disabled people are entitled to an interview, in some recruitment situations such as peak times, we might need to limit the overall numbers of interviews we offer.

If you have a disability that might affect any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know about any help or reasonable adjustments you need before any interview or assessment. We’ll work with you to make sure any appropriate support is in place and make the application process a more positive experience.

Corndel  is committed to safeguarding and safer recruitment practices, and will undertake pre-employment checks on the successful candidate, including DBS Disclosure.
